## Appearance

Anne is a slender girl with a pointed, freckled face, a little pointed chin, and a slim milk-white throat. Her hair is distinctly red—sometimes described as auburn or [Titian](../character/titian.md)—and has been worn long in braids, unbraided in a torrent of brightness, and even shingled closely after turning green. Her expressive, pale face features delicate, fine features, cheeks faintly flushed with pink, and a nose bearing seven freckles. She possesses large, solemn, and luminous gray eyes that are alluring as evening stars and reminiscent of her mother's.

## Personality

Extremely imaginative, poetic, and idealistic, she possesses a transparent, sensitive nature, though she is also stubborn, impulsive, and prone to reckless mistakes. Highly intense in both her loves and hatreds, she can cling to grudges, yet she is noted for being ungrudging, without envy, and genuinely joyful for her friends' happiness. Initially very talkative, she grows quieter over time, while remaining smart, obedient, and serious. Her practical skills include a knack with children, treating croup, rowing a dory, and singing. Driven by a desire to add beauty to life and understand others, she strives to excel academically and win scholarships to further her education, aspiring to teach and pursue writing. Her fears include passing through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley was orphaned at three months old and raised by Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) until age eight, later staying with Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) before spending four months in an asylum at [Hopeton](../codex/places.md#hopeton). Adopted by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), she moved to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she accidentally got her new friend [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk on currant wine before saving Diana's sister from croup to cement their friendship. Anne's early academic and personal life was marked by a fierce rivalry with classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), whom she struck with a slate after he called her names and whose initial offer of friendship she rejected after he rescued her from a sinking boat. Encouraged by her teacher Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), Anne tied for first place on the entrance exams for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), but after Matthew's sudden death, she forfeited her college scholarship to teach locally and care for Marilla's failing eyesight, during which time she reconciled with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). While living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Anne took in the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose permanent care was eventually secured by their uncle's legacy. Anne eventually attended [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), renting Patty's Place with friends and later receiving a thousand-dollar legacy from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/barry.md). During her college years, she turned down a marriage proposal from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and later rejected a proposal from [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) upon realizing she did not love him. After graduating, Anne returned home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed to her once more in Hester Gray's garden, and she happily accepted.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. ## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

> “I think he’s lovely,” said Anne reproachfully. “He is so very sympathetic. He didn’t mind how much I talked—he seemed to like it. I felt that he was a kindred spirit as soon as ever I saw him.”
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)

> "Oh, I don’t mean that sort of a name. I mean just a name you gave it yourself. Didn’t you give it a name? May I give it one then? May I call it—let me see—Bonny would do—may I call it Bonny while I’m here? Oh, do let me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P33](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0033)

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan is Avonlea's minister's wife and a valued friend to Anne, acting as a Sunday school teacher and an extra conscience for her. The two bonded early on when Mrs. Allan kindly comforted Anne after a liniment-flavored cake mishap, and their connection deepened through shared reflections on grief, teaching, and life choices.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began as Anne's academic rival after an early insult led to years of classroom competition. Though he rescued her from a sinking boat and harbor feelings for her, Anne long rejected his overtures until they eventually reconciled as best friends and study partners. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) later proposed marriage to her, which Anne rejected, leaving their personal dynamic strained.

### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--roy-gardner.md)

[Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) courted Anne during her college years, creating a flattered fancy that Anne temporarily mistook for true love. However, when [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) proposed to her after graduation, Anne realized her lack of deep affection and rejected him.
